title: Kissed Venezuelan bonito Ceviche
description: Herbal, tender ceviche served on a chilled cedar plank, featuring sherry vinegar and shaved bonito for a low-fat Venezuelan lunch.
instructions: Place cedar plank in a shallow dish and chill in the refrigerator for 10 minutes.
Thinly slice bonito fillet into 1mm strips and set aside.
In a bowl, whisk sherry vinegar, lime juice, oregano, pepper, and salt until combined.
Add bonito strips to the bowl and toss gently until coated.
Stir in sliced cucumber, red onion, scallion, and chopped cilantro.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 10 minutes to marinate.
Serve immediately on the chilled cedar plank, garnishing with additional cilantro if desired.
Enjoy the herbal, tender ceviche as a low-fat Venezuelan lunch.
